payload.instruction: Change the image into pencil drawing
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: To what extent has the image been transformed into a pencil drawing?
node.criteria: complete: the image consistently reads as a hand-drawn pencil drawing across the scene, with drawing-specific pencil marks and shading throughout; global desaturation or a grain/texture overlay alone is not enough. partial: visible pencil-drawing marks or shading show progress, but substantial regions still read as a photograph, including photographic detail, shading, or color. absent: no visible requested pencil-drawing transformation. unknown: evidence is insufficient to determine progress. Cite drawing-specific marks or shading and identify any remaining photographic regions when present; unrelated edits do not count.
node.binding: Target: the image. Reference: pencil drawing.

outcome.description: Transform the image into a pencil drawing.

response.content: {"status":"partial","evidence":"The edited image is muted and grainy, with some sketch-like texture on the food and plate, but the scene still retains photographic detail and shading across the meal, glassware, and tablecloth. It does not consistently read as a hand-drawn pencil drawing.","confidence":0.94}

parsed.evidence: The edited image is muted and grainy, with some sketch-like texture on the food and plate, but the scene still retains photographic detail and shading across the meal, glassware, and tablecloth. It does not consistently read as a hand-drawn pencil drawing.
